Subject: ACME MAP POC - MAP draft & POC env dependencies

Thanks again for taking the call today — great alignment on scope and next steps. Per our discussion, attaching the MAP draft and a short recap focused on the POC environment milestone. Please confirm owners and target dates so we can lock the MAP.

POC environment setup (MAP milestone) — dependencies and proposed owners:
- VPC peering / network connectivity
  - Owner: ACME Cloud Ops (tom.rivera@acme.com) / Redwood (network support: nikhil.sharma@redwood.com)
  - Redwood deliverable: public endpoint CIDRs + peering instructions + CloudFormation template
  - ACME deliverable: peering connection, route table updates, allowlists

- IP allowlists / firewall rules
  - Owner: ACME Cloud Ops
  - Action: open outbound/inbound ranges listed in attached network-reqs-acme.pdf

- SSO / SAML onboarding
  - Owner: ACME identity team (Julia) / Redwood security (marissa & security team)
  - Action: exchange SAML metadata; Redwood to provide SP metadata and SSO testing checklist

- Secrets / KMS access for POC (credentials management)
  - Owner: ACME security / Redwood infra (dev_patel@redwood.com for KMS guidance)
  - Action: confirm KMS key policy + service account/role to access secrets for the POC

Target dates (proposed):
- Confirm owners & schedule tech sync: by 2026-06-18
- Networking & allowlists completed: by 2026-06-28
- SSO/SAML exchange + test: by 2026-07-01
- POC environment ready / POC start: target 2026-07-05

Attachments: ACME_MAP_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and network-reqs-acme.pdf (IP ranges & ports).

Ask: can you please confirm (1) owner for VPC peering, (2) ACME SSO admin who will receive SAML metadata, and (3) availability for a 30-min tech sync this week or early next week?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198

- Ports: standard HTTPS (443) for control plane + 8000-8100 for optional telemetry (we can scope telemetry after POC if you prefer). No TLS inspection required for control plane; we recommend end-to-end TLS.
- SAML/SP metadata: posted to the Drive link (see related links) and also attached a short checklist. Julia — I'll send SP metadata directly to you after this thread.

Quick update from infra side — we will own the CloudFormation template and a short runbook for peering. Plan is:
1) Redwood provides CFN + example route table changes + sample security group rules (target: by EOD Tue 2026-06-16)
2) ACME creates peering connection and shares peering ID (ACME action)
3) Redwood validates routes and does a mutual connectivity test in the tech sync

Attaching the SAML onboarding checklist for reference.

- Nikhil
